## What is the problem?

A clear description of what is wrong, missing, or confusing. Include a link to the page or section if possible.

## Where does it appear?

- [ ] README
- [ ] User docs (docs.site)
- [ ] CONTRIBUTING.md
- [ ] Design docs (notes/dev/)
- [ ] Code comments
- [ ] Other

## What should it say instead?

If you have a suggested correction or addition, describe it here.

## Additional Context

Any other context — related issues, screenshots, etc.
